headline: Two late goals save Man City blushes against Bournemouth in Premier League opener
description: Late goals from Marc Guéhi and Josko Gvardiol rescued Manchester City who eventually beat Bournemouth 2-1 in their Premier League opener.

headline: European soccer live updates: Man City beat Bournemouth; Liverpool to face Newcastle
description: We have more matches this Sunday with Man City, Liverpool, Barcelona and more in action.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Nottingham Forest bid £70M for Igor Thiago
description: Nottingham Forest want Brazil striker Igor Thiago, and Barcelona continue their search for a No. 9. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Michael Carrick: 'Ridiculous' to claim Man United lack passion
description: Michael Carrick has hit back at criticism of his Manchester United players following the opening day defeat to Hull City by insisting it is "ridiculous" to claim they lacked passion.

headline: Record-breaking Archie Gray admits Tottenham performance 'wasn't good enough'
description: Archie Gray blasted Tottenham's dismal opening-day defeat at Brentford as "not good enough."

headline: New season, new haircut: Erling Haaland ditches iconic long hair for new season
description: Erling Haaland shared his latest viral social media post, showing him cutting his long blonde hair in favour of a buzz cut.
